name: Queen of Moths
source:
It's a winter night. You're returning home by train. It's been a long time since you've been there. You just have to transfer to another train. Just a moment's wait at a small train station in the middle of the forest.

You're familiar with this - it's not the first time you've traveled this route. However, this time, a strange uneasiness accompanies you. Something is different. Something is not right.

“We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.”

                                          - H. P. Lovecraft

[From [url=https://tesseractgames.itch.io/queen-of-moth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个冬天的夜晚。你要乘火车回家。你已经很久没来过那里了。你只需换乘另一趟火车即可。在森林中央的一个小火车站稍等片刻。

你对此很熟悉 - 这不是你第一次走这条路线。然而，这一次，一种奇怪的不安伴随着你。有些东西不一样了。有什么不对劲。

“我们生活在无边无际的黑海之中一座平静的无知岛屿上，这并不意味着我们应该远航。”

                                          ——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特

[来自[url=https://tesseractgames.itch.io/queen-of-moth]Itch.io[/url]]
